species.real: Inaccessible Island has no rats or cats, which is the only reason a bird the size of a sparrow can get by there without flying.
species.name: Thumbrail

dex.text: Small enough to sit on a thumb and has chosen a very large island to be small on. Never learned to fly. Has had no need to.
dex.fact: The Inaccessible Island rail, about the size of a sparrow, is the smallest flightless bird in the world; it lives only on Inaccessible Island, in the Tristan da Cunha group.
